questions.q: A ball is thrown vertically upwards with a speed of 20 m s^{-1}. Neglecting air resistance, the maximum height reached is (g = 10 m s^{-2})
The dimensions of Planck's constant *h* are
questions.explain: E = hf, so h = E / f. Energy is ML^{2}T^{-2} and frequency is T^{-1}, giving **ML^{2}T^{-1}** (unit J s).

A string of length 0.5 m is fixed at both ends. Its fundamental frequency is 200 Hz. The speed of transverse waves on the string is
questions.explain: In the fundamental mode L = λ/2, so λ = 1.0 m. Then v = fλ = 200 × 1.0 = **200 m s^{-1}**.

questions.q: A fixed mass of ideal gas at constant pressure has volume V at 27 °C. It is heated to 327 °C. Its new volume is
questions.explain: Use kelvin, not °C: T_{1} = 300 K and T_{2} = 600 K. At constant pressure V ∝ T, so the volume doubles: **2V**. (Choosing 12V means you used °C.)

questions.q: Light of photon energy 5.0 eV falls on a metal of work function 2.0 eV. The maximum kinetic energy of the emitted photoelectrons is
questions.explain: Einstein's photoelectric equation: K_{max} = hf − φ = 5.0 − 2.0 = **3.0 eV**.

questions.q: A car starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to 20 m s^{-1} in 5 s. The distance it travels in this time is
questions.explain: For uniform acceleration, distance = average speed × time = ((0 + 20) / 2) × 5 = **50 m**.

questions.q: An object is placed 15 cm from a thin converging lens of focal length 10 cm. The magnification of the image is
questions.explain: Using 1/u + 1/v = 1/f (real is positive): 1/v = 1/10 − 1/15 = 1/30, so v = 30 cm. Magnification m = v / u = 30 / 15 = **2**.

questions.q: The heat needed to raise the temperature of 2 kg of water by 10 K is (specific heat capacity of water = 4200 J kg^{-1} K^{-1})
Two point charges exert a force F on each other. If one charge is doubled and the distance between them is also doubled, the new force is
questions.explain: F ∝ q_{1}q_{2} / r^{2}. Doubling one charge gives ×2; doubling r gives ÷4. So the new force = 2F / 4 = **F / 2**.
